description: Dreamwalker Tunic Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Tunic if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Tunic - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 25 - Cured Rugged Hide x 6 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Dreamwalker Tunic
